prediction_qc.scope: Structural/integrity QC only: scheduler completion, chunk union, frame coverage, canonical references, and prediction-count distributions. This is not labeled pose-accuracy evaluation.

pre_link_3d.residual_gate_interpretation: No residual gate was applied when score_gate.value is null. A zero dropped_high_residual count therefore does not mean the residual tail is absent; use the explicit tail counts and worst frames above.

missing_view_policy.refractive: direct intersection of the two observed refracted rays
missing_view_policy.polynomial: legacy pairwise-helper completion inside polynomial backend

final_3d.final_nonfinite_gap_interpretation: The final nonfinite gaps are evaluated separately from not-directly-observed/interpolated geometry runs. A 100% post-frame-5000 all-three-finite fraction establishes that final nonfinite gaps are startup-only; it does not imply that every later row is directly observed rather than interpolated.

identity_binding.mapping_interpretation: A stable global one-to-one mapping is structural continuity evidence. It does not prove biological identity correctness through smooth contacts/crossings.

missing_view_policy.refractive: direct intersection of the two observed refracted rays
missing_view_policy.polynomial: legacy pairwise-helper completion inside polynomial backend

quality_gate.status_interpretation: Review is mandatory even when structural checks pass. The configured 8 mm adjacent-link gate makes zero >20 mm accepted steps expected; it is not independent proof of identity quality.
quality_gate.identity_caveat: A stable one-to-one relabel and bounded/zero over-threshold adjacent steps characterize bounded geometric continuity. They do not establish biological identity correctness at smooth contacts or crossings.
